description: This file defines a React component for visualizing a mind map of recommended roles tailored to a user's persona, including functions for fetching data, filtering roles, and managing view state.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes input to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into an array of non-empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object, normalizing various potential property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from a role object, checking multiple possible property names.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range string into a numeric min and max in lakhs (USD thousands), handling various formats and currency indicators.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role matches selected industry, skills, and salary range filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations based on persona ID and optional modes from an API.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state into a viewport object with pan and zoom.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport object and selected node ID into a persisted view state.
